# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our commitment
Participants should feel welcome to contribute technical insights, ask questions, and report problems respectfully.

## Expected behavior
- Focus criticism on code, evidence, and design decisions rather than people.
- Discuss privacy and biometric limitations with care.
- Keep private photographs, access tokens, SMTP credentials, and personal records out of public issues.
- Respect the MIT source license and separate dataset/model licenses.

## Unacceptable behavior
Harassment, discrimination, threats, publishing private information without authorization, and deliberately disruptive conduct are unacceptable.

## Enforcement
Report conduct concerns privately to **Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>**. Reports are evaluated in context and handled proportionately.
